summary: Round 2 frontend E2E (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080, admin@pa.com). All 9 requested flows pass: login/dashboard, Finance GST split, Settings fees + e-Sign tab, Agreements e-Sign-only flow, Complaints owner/tenant tabs + resolution, Leaving approve + move-out, Banners per-app CRUD/reorder/remove/restore, Notifications selected/scheduled sends, Coupons multi-owner eligibility + validation. No page errors or compile overlay on any page. One medium UX bug in UserPicker (stale selections kept when the eligibility user type changes), plus a few minor items.

ui_bugs.issue: Steps: choose 'Multiple Selected Owners', pick owners, then switch to 'Multiple Selected Tenants' (or 'Selected Tenant'). The OWN-* chips stay, and because the name lookup now runs with type=tenant they show the raw ID twice ('OWN-10001 OWN-10001'). Submitting gives the backend error 'Some selected users are not valid tenants'. Switching from multiple to single ('Selected Owner') also keeps all 3 chips, and the user only gets 'Select exactly one user for single-user eligibility' on submit. Fix: clear eligible_ids when the resolved userType changes, and trim to the last pick when single becomes true.

The review request says the testid is agreement-fee-0..12, but the actual testid is setting-agreement-fee-0..12 (the Num helper adds the setting- prefix). Works fine. Only the test contract or docs differ.

issues: At 1920px the table overflows horizontally; the Ver., Status and Created columns are cut off and need a horizontal scroll
Sortable headers are mixed-case ('Total received', 'Fee') and non-sortable ones are UPPERCASE ('BASE', 'GST', 'TOTAL'), which looks inconsistent in the same header row
The date and datetime fields (banner and coupon dates, notification schedule, table date filters) use the browser's native picker instead of the shadcn Calendar
The 'Sent' column shows the creation time even for scheduled campaigns. Consider renaming it to 'Created'
'Requested by' shows only 'Tenant' with no name. requested_by_name is empty for all 22 seeded requests

action_items: UserPicker/Coupons: reset eligible_ids when the eligibility user type changes (owner<->tenant), and enforce a single selection in the UI when single=true
Optional: align the agreement fee testids with the spec (agreement-fee-N) or update the docs
Optional: make the Agreements table fit at 1920px, keep table header casing consistent, and use the shadcn date picker

Seed data gap: no complaint has attachments, every complaint has only 1 message, all leaving requests are tenant-raised and none has requested_by_name. Photo/video rendering, multi-party reply threads and owner-raised leaving could not be checked visually
critical_code_review_comments: UserPicker: when `type` changes, the component remounts (key=t in FormDialog) but the parent value is kept, so stale cross-type IDs remain
UserPicker: the `single` prop only affects new adds; it doesn't trim an existing multi-selection
Banners: the move() reorder sends only the current tab's visible (non-removed) ids. Fine per tab, but removed banners keep their old order numbers
Complaints status dialog offers only open/in_progress/resolved; escalated and reopened are reached through the dedicated buttons. OK
seed_data_creation: Created through the UI: banner BNR-10007 'TEST_ Tenant Banner' (tenant, restored as inactive); notification campaigns NTC-10001 (2 selected owners) and NTC-10002 (all 42 owners, scheduled 25 Dec 2026); coupon TESTMULTI2. Changed seeded records: complaint CMP-10008 set to resolved; leaving LVR-10022 approved and move-out set to scheduled; settings agreement fee for Flat/Apartment changed 99->106 and back to 99 (settings version is now 3).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button. DataTable rows use {testid||entity}-row-{id}. Complaint tables use complaints-owner/tenant. The e-Sign 'no provider configured' toast is expected. Agreement AGR-10051 is pending_signature with an approved payment (good for e-Sign tests). Fee inputs: setting-agreement-fee-0..12.
rca of the issue: Stale picker selection: FormDialog keeps vals.eligible_ids across eligibility changes. UserPicker is keyed by user type, so the search list resets but the value array is not cleared. Mitigation: in the FormDialog onChange for eligibility (or a useEffect in UserPicker on type change), call onChange([]). When single, call onChange(value.slice(-1)).
